errors.description: The displayed eigenvalues omit the normalization factor 1/4 from the definition of ρ in Eq. (1).
errors.evidence: Setting all coefficients to zero gives ρ = I₄/4, whose four eigenvalues are 1/4, while Eqs. (6)–(7) give four eigenvalues equal to 1. More generally, diagonalizing ρ = (I₄ + A)/4 scales each eigenvalue of I₄ + A by 1/4.

errors.description: The claimed swap-dependent Horodecki nonlocality does not follow: swapping the qubits transposes the correlation matrix, which preserves the eigenvalues used by the criterion. The row/column products in Eq. (8) also do not have the displayed spectra.
errors.evidence: If β′ = βᵀ after swapping, then β′ᵀβ′ = ββᵀ, and ββᵀ and βᵀβ have the same eigenvalues (the squared singular values of β). In particular, a β with just one nonzero row has βᵀβ of rank at most one with nonzero eigenvalue equal to the sum of the row's squared entries; its transpose has the same spectrum. Thus the sum of the two largest eigenvalues, and hence the stated criterion M > 1, is invariant under the defined swap, contrary to the asymmetry asserted in (8)–(9) and the construction in Theorem 1.4.
